proposed_ui_capabilities: MFA challenge and TOTP verification using existing contract
Web session handoff using approved secure cookie behavior
Membership and selected-organization choice from the current user's memberships
Authenticated shell with navigation affordances derived from selected membership role codes
Read-only paginated incident list and incident detail
Loading, empty, generic error, forbidden, not-found, and expired-session states
excluded_incident_fields: outcome unless separately approved for the read-only projection

security_constraints: No credential, access token, refresh token, MFA seed, or recovery code in browser storage, URLs, telemetry, screenshots, or logs
Cookie session uses documented trusted-origin and CSRF protections
Every tenant request sends the selected organization as an untrusted selector and relies on backend membership, assurance, permission, and RLS enforcement
Role-based navigation is presentation only; backend authorization remains authoritative
No incident creation, editing, transition, assignment, movement, dispatch, GPS, media, or reporting UI
dependencies: Review actual WEB cookie/session handoff behavior against existing HTTP tests before implementation
Keep MFA-required role assurance and tenant-only privileged MFA behavior
Use synthetic accounts and isolated test data only
